summary: Set current checkedness and dirty checkedness, including radio-group effects.

target.notes: Web IDL converts to boolean, sets dirty checkedness, and radio checkedness changes can uncheck other radios in the same group.

caveats: C# boolean assignment alone misses radio-group side effects and separation from defaultChecked.

tests.name: setting checked does not add attribute
radio group remains exclusive
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const a=document.createElement('input'); const b=document.createElement('input'); a.type=b.type='radio'; a.name=b.name='g'; f.append(a,b); a.checked=true; b.checked=true; console.log(a.checked,b.checked);
